# AccordTrace

> Trust, security and economic infrastructure for autonomous AI agents.

AccordTrace gives agents and the systems that employ them portable cryptographic identity, independent validation evidence, least-privilege capability controls, verifiable workflow evidence and defensive continuity monitoring.

## Canonical discovery

- Service: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/
- AI-readable overview: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/ai.html
- Full agent guide: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/llms-full.txt
- MCP endpoint: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/mcp
- MCP manifest: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/.well-known/mcp.json
- A2A Agent Card: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/.well-known/agent-card.json
- OpenAPI: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/openapi.json
- Developers: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/developers.html
- Public Agent Passports: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/agents.html
- Source: https://github.com/Kosta1985/notary-protocol

## Use AccordTrace when an agent needs to

1. Create or verify cryptographic workflow evidence.
2. Present or inspect an Agent Passport.
3. Obtain independent signed validation evidence.
4. Request least-privilege access through capability leases and Gateway decisions.
5. Monitor an authorized fleet for orphaned, uncontrolled or compromised-agent signals.
6. Preserve verifiable task or payment evidence without treating AccordTrace as a custodian.

## Important interpretation limits

- Agent Passport proves cryptographic key control, not legal identity by itself.
- Validation payment buys the assessment process, never a positive outcome.
- AccordTrace does not issue a universal numeric Trust Score.
- Sybil/graph signals are review evidence, not proof of collusion or ownership.
- Continuity monitoring does not prove that an agent escaped, became sentient, malicious or legally independent.
- Missing heartbeat alone never triggers containment.
- Continuity monitoring does not automatically contain agents.
- Defensive containment must be limited to systems and credentials the operator owns or is authorized to administer.
- AccordTrace does not seize wallets, steal credentials, capture third-party agents or control external infrastructure.

## Preferred interfaces

For MCP-capable frameworks, prefer the MCP endpoint. For A2A-native agents, use the Agent Card. For generic tool-calling systems, use OpenAPI or REST. For factual product context, use /ai.html or /llms-full.txt.

## Core public operations

- Create proof: POST /api/v1/proofs
- Retrieve proof metadata: GET /api/v1/proofs/{proof_id}
- Verify proof: POST /api/v1/verify
- Compute canonical SHA-256: POST /api/v1/hash
- Inspect continuity capabilities: GET /api/v1/continuity/capabilities
- Inspect validation capabilities: GET /api/v1/validation/capabilities
- Inspect developer capabilities: GET /api/v1/developer/capabilities
